entries.047264087559655a: This is a [[term:segment|segment]] engaged in banking and related businesses, consisting of four companies in total: Sony Bank Inc. and three equity-method affiliates. Sony Bank provides deposits (yen and foreign currency), housing loans, investment trusts and foreign exchange margin trading, among others, through the internet. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥129,839 million. Ordinary revenue including intersegment transactions rose 11.0% year on year, as funding income, such as interest on loans and interest and dividends on securities, increased, while housing loan-related service income decreased.

entries.10ce719cf6e8b230: Sony Life provides custom-designed life insurance based on detailed consulting by life planners (sales staff) and partners (sales agencies). Sony Assurance provides auto, fire and medical insurance via the internet and telephone, and the share of auto insurance in direct net premiums written for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 85.67%. Sony Bank provides deposits (yen and foreign currency), housing loans, investment trusts and foreign exchange margin trading via the internet. In addition, there is the elder care business, which plans, develops and operates paid nursing homes, and the venture capital business.
entries.17c0ad8a6abe0095: This is the business undertaken by Sony Financial Ventures Inc. Together with Global Brain Corporation, it has set up an investment limited liability partnership.
entries.28828b14dec2ecf8: The group is centered on Sony Life Insurance Co., Ltd., Sony Assurance Inc. and Sony Bank Inc., and the company is a financial holding company that has these as its direct [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]]. The company also includes in its scope of consolidation Sony Lifecare Inc., which oversees the elder care business, and Sony Financial Ventures Inc., which handles the venture capital business. There are 11 consolidated subsidiaries and 3 equity-method affiliates, and consolidated headcount at the end of the fiscal year ended March 2026 was 14,042. The company has management agreements with its subsidiaries and receives management fees. The 'Sony' trade name and trademarks belong to SONY GROUP CORPORATION; the company has a trade name and trademark license agreement with SONY GROUP CORPORATION, and its subsidiaries use them under sublicense agreements with the company.
entries.2d29057f13f9898e: The main customers are policyholders of Sony Life's individual life and individual annuity insurance and Sony Assurance's auto insurance, and depositors and housing loan borrowers at Sony Bank. entries.71601033163c8618: Consolidated ordinary revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,871,029 million (up 9.6% year on year), and ordinary revenue from external customers was ¥2,531,621 million for the life insurance business, ¥191,320 million for the non-life insurance business, ¥129,839 million for the banking business and ¥18,247 million for other.
